intent_en: To illustrate the extremely thin profit margins typical in grocery retail businesses.
previous_intent: To illustrate the notoriously thin profit margins in the retail grocery sector.
narration_support: If you're lucky, you might manage a profit margin of 3%.
chart_support: A circular chart featuring a shopping basket icon and a small segment labeled 3%, visualizing a low percentage.
evidence_note: The narration discusses profit margins in the context of selling bananas (grocery retail), and the chart visualizes a shopping basket with a 3% indicator, reinforcing the concept of low profitability.
